name: Deterministic Git Workflow Sync
description: Fully deterministic git sync using only bash resolvers. Fetches latest changes, handles uncommitted work, rebases on remote, and pushes. No LLM reasoning needed - pure bash execution with proper error handling.

variables.name: workDir
variables.description: Working directory (must be a git repository)

variables.name: autoStash
variables.description: Automatically stash uncommitted changes before rebase

variables.name: forcePush
variables.description: Use --force-with-lease for push (needed after rebase that changes history)

variables.name: skipPush
variables.description: Skip pushing to remote (for dry-run testing)

variables.name: skipRebase
variables.description: Skip rebase step (just fetch and push)

tasks.description: Validate working directory is a git repository

config.command: set -e; cd '{{workDir}}'; if ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: Not a git repository: {{workDir}}'; exit 1; fi; BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); REMOTE_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null || echo 'none'); echo "REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; echo "CURRENT_BRANCH=$BRANCH"; echo "REMOTE_TRACKING=$REMOTE_BRANCH"; echo 'Git repository validated'

set -e; cd '{{workDir}}'; echo '=== Fetching from {{remoteName}} ==='; git fetch {{remoteName}} --prune || { echo 'ERROR: Failed to fetch from {{remoteName}}'; exit 1; }; BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count {{remoteName}}/$BRANCH..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo '0'); BEHIND=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..{{remoteName}}/$BRANCH 2>/dev/null || echo '0'); echo "AHEAD=$AHEAD commits ahead of remote"; echo "BEHIND=$BEHIND commits behind remote"; echo 'Fetch completed'

tasks.description: Check for uncommitted changes and optionally stash them

config.command: set -e; cd '{{workDir}}'; AUTO_STASH='{{autoStash}}'; echo '=== Checking for uncommitted changes ==='; CHANGES=$(git status --porcelain); if [ -z "$CHANGES" ]; then echo 'WORKING_TREE=clean'; echo 'No uncommitted changes'; exit 0; fi; echo 'WORKING_TREE=dirty'; echo "Changes detected:"; echo "$CHANGES" | head -20; if [ "$AUTO_STASH" = 'true' ]; then STASH_MSG="auto-stash-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"; echo "Stashing changes as: $STASH_MSG"; git stash push -m "$STASH_MSG" --include-untracked || { echo 'ERROR: Failed to stash changes'; exit 1; }; echo 'STASHED=true'; else echo 'STASHED=false'; echo 'WARNING: Uncommitted changes exist but autoStash=false'; echo 'Rebase may fail or include unwanted changes'; fi

tasks.description: Rebase current branch on remote tracking branch

config.command: SKIP='{{skipRebase}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipRebase=true'; exit 0; fi; set -e; cd '{{workDir}}'; BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); REMOTE_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -z "$REMOTE_BRANCH" ]; then echo 'WARNING: No upstream tracking branch configured'; echo 'Attempting to rebase on {{remoteName}}/$BRANCH'; REMOTE_BRANCH="{{remoteName}}/$BRANCH"; fi; echo "=== Rebasing $BRANCH onto $REMOTE_BRANCH ==="; BEHIND=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..$REMOTE_BRANCH 2>/dev/null || echo '0'); if [ "$BEHIND" = '0' ]; then echo 'Already up to date, no rebase needed'; exit 0; fi; echo "$BEHIND commits to rebase"; git rebase "$REMOTE_BRANCH" || { echo 'ERROR: Rebase failed (conflicts detected)'; echo 'Run: git rebase --abort  to undo'; echo 'Run: git rebase --continue  after resolving conflicts'; exit 1; }; echo 'Rebase completed successfully'

SKIP='{{skipPush}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipPush=true'; exit 0; fi; set -e; cd '{{workDir}}'; BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); FORCE='{{forcePush}}'; echo "=== Pushing $BRANCH to {{remoteName}} ==="; AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count {{remoteName}}/$BRANCH..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo '0'); if [ "$AHEAD" = '0' ]; then echo 'Nothing to push (already in sync)'; exit 0; fi; echo "$AHEAD commits to push"; if [ "$FORCE" = 'true' ]; then echo 'Using --force-with-lease (safe force push)'; git push --force-with-lease {{remoteName}} $BRANCH || { echo 'ERROR: Force push failed'; exit 1; }; else git push {{remoteName}} $BRANCH || { echo 'ERROR: Push failed'; echo 'If rebase changed history, use forcePush=true'; exit 1; }; fi; echo 'Push completed'

tasks.description: Restore stashed changes if any were stashed

config.command: cd '{{workDir}}'; echo '=== Checking for stashed changes ==='; STASH_LIST=$(git stash list | grep 'auto-stash-' | head -1 || echo ''); if [ -z "$STASH_LIST" ]; then echo 'No auto-stash found, nothing to restore'; exit 0; fi; echo "Found stash: $STASH_LIST"; echo 'Restoring stashed changes...'; git stash pop || { echo 'WARNING: Stash pop failed (may have conflicts)'; echo 'Manual resolution may be needed'; echo 'Stash still available: git stash list'; exit 0; }; echo 'Stash restored successfully'

cd '{{workDir}}'; BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD); REMOTE_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null || echo 'none'); STATUS=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null || echo 'clean'); AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count {{remoteName}}/$BRANCH..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo '0'); BEHIND=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..{{remoteName}}/$BRANCH 2>/dev/null || echo '0'); cat > '{{outputFile}}' << 'REPORT_EOF'
# Git Sync Status Report

## Branch Info
- **Local Branch**: $BRANCH
- **Remote Tracking**: $REMOTE_BRANCH
- **Current Commit**: $COMMIT

## Sync Status
- **Ahead**: $AHEAD commits
- **Behind**: $BEHIND commits

## Working Tree
```
$STATUS
```

## Recent Commits
REPORT_EOF
git log --oneline -5 >> '{{outputFile}}' 2>/dev/null; echo ''; echo "Report written to: {{outputFile}}"; echo 'Sync completed successfully'

improvements_over_original: Fully deterministic - no LLM reasoning needed
All tasks use bash resolver instead of prompt/subagent
Proper error handling with exit codes
Configurable force-push option for rebase scenarios
